Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer

Class FlightComputerSensors

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer.FlightComputerSensors
public final class FlightComputerSensors extends Object
Per-flight sensor acquisition at accepted FC sample boundaries, with stable-ID random streams.
